name: decimen-optical-transfer
description: Maintained fork of bashalarmistalt/decimen-optical-transfer with arbitrary file transfer, PWA support, and image optimization.

paragraphs: Transfer files directly from one device's screen to another device's camera with an animated, fountain-coded QR stream. The transfer needs no network path between the devices, account, pairing, native app, or intermediary server: the payload travels as light.
Status: maintained prototype. The web app is usable today; the current payload limit is 2 MB and the macOS package is unsigned and not notarized.
This repository is a maintained fork of bashalarmistalt/decimen-optical-transfer. It preserves the original MIT license and credits.
features: Transfers any file up to 2 MB while preserving its name and media type.
Optimizes JPEG, PNG, and WebP images larger than 1 MB in the browser.
Accepts files from the system picker or screenshots pasted from the clipboard.
Optionally sends files from the CLI through a local, browser-rendered QR stream.
Uses fountain coding, so missed or out-of-order frames do not require a restart.

requirements.text: The transfer needs no network path between the devices, account, pairing, native app, or intermediary server: the payload travels as light.
It does not require administrator privileges or an Apple Developer account.
During setup, choose the public host, enter a custom HTTPS host, or display the self-hosting instructions.
